description: This file contains functions related to handling hexadecimal representations of hashes and object IDs within a Git-like system, including conversion, parsing, and algorithms-specific operations.

methods.name: int get_hash_hex_algop(const char * hex,unsigned char * hash,const struct git_hash_algo * algop)
methods.description: Converts a hex string into a hash using a specified algorithm.

methods.name: int get_hash_hex(const char * hex,unsigned char * sha1)
methods.description: Converts a hex string into a SHA-1 hash.

methods.name: int get_oid_hex_algop(const char * hex,struct object_id * oid,const struct git_hash_algo * algop)
methods.description: Parses a hex string into an object_id structure using a specific algorithm.

methods.name: int get_oid_hex_any(const char * hex,struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Attempts to parse a hex string into an object_id using multiple algorithms.

methods.name: int get_oid_hex(const char * hex,struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Parses a hex string into an object_id using the default hash algorithm.

methods.name: int parse_oid_hex_algop(const char * hex,struct object_id * oid,const char ** end,const struct git_hash_algo * algop)
methods.description: Parses a hex string into an object_id with a specified algorithm and sets the end pointer.

methods.name: int parse_oid_hex_any(const char * hex,struct object_id * oid,const char ** end)
methods.description: Attempts to parse a hex string into an object_id with any known algorithms and sets the end pointer.

methods.name: int parse_oid_hex(const char * hex,struct object_id * oid,const char ** end)
methods.description: Parses a hex string into an object_id using default algorithm and sets the end pointer.

methods.name: char * hash_to_hex_algop_r(char * buffer,const unsigned char * hash,const struct git_hash_algo * algop)
methods.description: Converts a hash to its hex string representation using a specified algorithm.

methods.name: char * oid_to_hex_r(char * buffer,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Converts an object_id to its hex string representation.

methods.name: char * hash_to_hex_algop(const unsigned char * hash,const struct git_hash_algo * algop)
methods.description: Provides a static buffer to convert a hash into a hex string with a specified algorithm.

methods.name: char * hash_to_hex(const unsigned char * hash)
methods.description: Converts a hash to hex string using the default hash algorithm.

methods.name: char * oid_to_hex(const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Converts an object_id to its hex string representation.
